front: Who has unlimited IRS practice rights?

back: Promptly advise the client of the error and its consequences; don't fix it without consent.
Exam of an original return; amended return or claim within 120 days of an IRS notice; interest and penalty claims; judicial proceedings.
Return records needed for the client's compliance, even in a fee dispute.
Informed written consent from each affected client, confirmed within 30 days.
